list.name: zone
list.label: Hosting zone (what-if)
list.description: Override the grid intensity used to recompute operational carbon. 'Measured' keeps the original Electricity-Maps value of each run. Annual averages (Ember 2024) in gCO₂eq/kWh.
list.query: Measured : 0,France : 56,Germany : 380,Poland : 660,Sweden : 30,Norway : 30,Spain : 150,Italy : 270,United Kingdom : 200,Netherlands : 330,Ireland : 290,US Virginia : 280,US California : 230,US Texas : 410,Canada Québec : 30,Brazil : 100,India : 700,China : 580,Japan : 460,Australia (SE) : 540,South Africa : 900,World average : 475

panels.title: Mean SCI
panels.description: Mean SCI per run over the time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, repository, sci_value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1;
SELECT repository, SUM(total_gco2eq) AS total FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: What-if scenario  ·  zone=$zone · X=$runs_per_day runs/day · Y=$days_per_year days/yr
Projected runs / year
panels.description: X × Y. Drives the projected-annual stats and the breakdown panel below.

panels.title: Projected energy / year
panels.description: Mean energy per run over the time window × (X × Y).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(energy_kwh), 0) * (${runs_per_day:raw}::float * ${days_per_year:raw}::float) AS projected_kwh FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at);

panels.title: Projected carbon / year
panels.description: Mean per-run carbon (with optional zone override) × (X × Y). Auto-scaled to g / kg / t.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN ${zone:raw}::float > 0 THEN energy_kwh * ${zone:raw}::float ELSE operational_gco2eq END) + AVG(embodied_gco2eq), 0) * (${runs_per_day:raw}::float * ${days_per_year:raw}::float) AS projected_gco2eq FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at);

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN ${zone:raw}::float > 0 THEN energy_kwh * ${zone:raw}::float ELSE operational_gco2eq END) + AVG(embodied_gco2eq), 0) * (${runs_per_day:raw}::float * ${days_per_year:raw}::float) / 170.0 AS km FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at);

panels.title: Energy breakdown by step  ·  × $runs_per_day × $days_per_year
panels.description: Per-step kWh summed across the window, then scaled by the X × Y multiplier to give projected annual energy. Auto-scaled to Wh / kWh / MWh / GWh / TWh.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS step, SUM(s.kwh) * (${runs_per_day:raw}::float * ${days_per_year:raw}::float) AS projected_kwh FROM run_steps s JOIN runs r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY projected_kwh DESC;

panels.title: Carbon footprint — operational vs embodied  ·  zone=$zone
panels.description: Daily totals split between operational carbon (Scope 2, location-based) and embodied carbon (Scope 3.1, amortised hardware). Operational is recomputed against the selected hosting zone when not 'Measured'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at) AS day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ${zone:raw}::float > 0 THEN energy_kwh * ${zone:raw}::float ELSE operational_gco2eq END)::numeric, 2) AS operational, ROUND(SUM(embodied_gco2eq)::numeric, 2) AS embodied FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT arch, SUM(energy_kwh) AS kwh FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1;

SELECT started_at, repository, workflow, arch, grid_zone, ROUND(grid_intensity::numeric,0) AS i, energy_kwh AS kwh, total_gco2eq AS co2, sci_value AS sci FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50;
